title: Phileas Redaction Policy
description: Schema for a Phileas redaction policy JSON file. A policy defines which types of sensitive information to detect and how to redact or transform each type.

metadata.description: Optional descriptive information about the policy. Ignored during redaction.

config.description: Global configuration settings for the policy.

crypto.description: AES encryption settings used by the CRYPTO_REPLACE strategy.

fpe.description: Format-preserving encryption settings used by the FPE_ENCRYPT_REPLACE strategy.

identifiers.description: Defines which types of sensitive information to detect and how to handle each type.

ignored.description: Lists of terms to ignore globally during filtering.

ignoredPatterns.description: Regex patterns to ignore globally during filtering.

graphical.description: Graphical redaction settings for image and PDF redaction.

generators.description: Named, reusable replacement generators referenced by the MAP_REPLACE strategy's generator property.

metadata.description: Descriptive information about the policy, carried with the policy itself so it survives export, import, and sharing. Nothing here affects detection or redaction; an engine reads and writes it unchanged. Additional properties are allowed so the object can grow (author, timestamps, labels) without a breaking schema change.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the policy does.

validatorName.description: Name of a built-in checksum or structural validator the identifier filter may apply to its matches. The set is the source-of-truth catalog spec/v1.0/catalog/validators.yaml; this enum is kept in sync with it. Most national and financial identifiers reduce to the shared algorithms (luhn, mod11, mod97, mod23-letter); the remainder are specific named validators.

config.description: Global configuration settings for the policy.

splitting.description: Controls whether and how input text is split into smaller chunks before filtering.
Controls whether and how input text is split into smaller chunks before filtering.

threshold.description: Character count threshold above which text is split.

overlap.description: Number of characters each chunk shares with the end of the previous chunk when text is split. An entity that straddles a chunk boundary is still seen whole within the overlap window; spans detected in the overlap are de-duplicated and mapped back to their absolute document offsets. Default 0 (no overlap; chunks are contiguous).

redactionColor.description: Policy-wide color of the redaction box drawn over redacted text in PDFs, used for any span whose strategy does not set its own color. Accepts a named color (black, white, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, gray) or a 6-digit hex string matching ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$; an unrecognized or malformed value renders as black.

showReplacement.description: Whether to render replacement text inside the redaction box.

replacementFont.description: Font used for replacement text in PDFs.

replacementMaxFontSize.description: Maximum font size for replacement text in PDFs.

replacementFontColor.description: Color of the replacement text in PDFs.

compressionQuality.description: JPEG compression quality for PDF output (0.0 to 1.0).

preserveUnredactedPages.description: Whether to preserve pages that contain no redactions in their original form.

removeTrailingPeriods.description: Remove trailing periods from redacted output.

removeTrailingSpaces.description: Remove trailing spaces from redacted output.

removeTrailingNewLines.description: Remove trailing newlines from redacted output.

spanDisambiguation.description: Enable span disambiguation: the context-vector step that resolves which type an ambiguously-typed span is (for example SSN vs. phone number). Default true (current behavior). When false, this policy skips the disambiguation step. Subject to the global feature also being enabled: a policy can turn disambiguation off but not force it on when it is disabled globally.

crypto.description: AES-GCM encryption settings used by the CRYPTO_REPLACE strategy. A fresh random nonce is generated per value, so no initialization vector is configured. Values may be prefixed with 'env:' to read from environment variables.

key.description: AES encryption key. Prefix with 'env:' to read from an environment variable (e.g. 'env:CRYPTO_KEY').

fpe.description: Format-preserving encryption settings used by the FPE_ENCRYPT_REPLACE strategy. Values may be prefixed with 'env:' to read from environment variables.

key.description: FPE encryption key. Prefix with 'env:' to read from an environment variable.

tweak.description: FPE tweak value. Prefix with 'env:' to read from an environment variable.

ignored.description: A named list of terms to ignore during filtering.

files.description: Paths to files containing terms to ignore (one term per line).

ignoredPattern.description: A named regex pattern whose matches are ignored during filtering.

pattern.description: Java-compatible regular expression. Matches are excluded from filtering.

graphical.description: Graphical redaction settings for image and PDF redaction.

boundingBoxes.description: Fixed bounding boxes to redact in images or PDFs.

boundingBox.description: A rectangular region to redact in an image or PDF page.

color.description: Fill color for the redaction box. Accepts a named color (black, white, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, gray) or a 6-digit hex string matching ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$; an unrecognized or malformed value renders as black.

x.description: X coordinate of the top-left corner.

y.description: Y coordinate of the top-left corner.

enabled.description: Whether this bounding box is active.

ignoredFiles.description: Paths to files containing values to ignore.

ignoredPatterns.description: Regex patterns whose matches are ignored.

windowSize.description: Context window size (number of surrounding tokens to consider).

priority.description: Priority of this filter relative to others. Higher values take precedence.

abstractFilterProperties.description: Common properties inherited by all filters.

ignored.description: Specific values to ignore for this filter.

ignoredFiles.description: Paths to files containing values to ignore for this filter.

ignoredPatterns.description: Regex patterns whose matches are ignored by this filter.

windowSize.description: Context window size (number of surrounding tokens to consider).

priority.description: Priority of this filter relative to others. Higher values take precedence.

id.description: Optional identifier for this filter, assigned by the policy author or generated, so the filter can be referenced in logs and diagnostics without printing content that may be PII. Opaque to redaction behavior: it never changes how a document is filtered. Must not itself contain PII.

baseFilterStrategy.description: Common properties for all filter strategies.

id.description: Optional identifier for this strategy instance, assigned by the policy author or generated, so the strategy and its condition can be referenced in logs and diagnostics without printing content that may be PII. Opaque to redaction behavior: it never changes how a document is filtered. Must not itself contain PII.

redactionFormat.description: Format string for REDACT strategy. Supports placeholders: %t (filter type), %v (original value), %l (label).

replacementScope.description: Scope for consistent replacements. DOCUMENT: same token always gets same replacement within a document. CONTEXT: same token gets same replacement within a context.

maskLength.description: Length of the mask. SAME preserves the original length. Can also be a number for fixed-length masking.

truncateLeaveCharacters.description: Number of characters to leave visible when using TRUNCATE strategy.

truncateCharacter.description: Character used to replace truncated portions.

truncateDirection.description: Which end of the value to truncate.

condition.description: Conditional expression that must be satisfied for this strategy to apply. If every strategy on a filter has a condition and none is satisfied, the value is left unchanged. Supports fields: token, context, confidence, population. Operators: startswith, ==, !=, >, <, >=, <=, is, is not. Multiple conditions joined with and. Example: 'confidence > 0.9', 'confidence > 0.5 and confidence < 0.9', 'token startswith "5"', 'population < 4500', 'token is birthdate'.

salt.description: Whether to add a random salt to hashed values (HASH_SHA256_REPLACE).

anonymizationCandidates.description: Custom candidate values for FROM_LIST anonymization method.

mappings.description: MAP_REPLACE lookup table mapping a detected value to its replacement. Inline entries take precedence over any loaded from mappingFiles.

mappingFiles.description: MAP_REPLACE: local file paths (TSV, one tab-delimited key/value pair per row) merged into the lookup table at policy-load time. Inline mappings override entries loaded from files.

caseSensitive.description: MAP_REPLACE: whether lookup-table keys are matched case-sensitively.

generator.description: MAP_REPLACE: name of a generator declared in the top-level generators block, invoked to produce a replacement for a detected value absent from the lookup table.

fallbackStrategy.description: MAP_REPLACE: terminal strategy applied when a detected value is absent from the lookup table and no generator is set, or when the generator fails, times out, or returns invalid output. A detected value is never left in the clear.

color.description: Optional color of the bar drawn over a span redacted by this strategy when rendering a PDF or image. Overrides the policy-wide config.pdf.redactionColor for spans this strategy redacts; when unset, the policy-wide color (default black) applies. Accepts a named color (black, white, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, gray) or a 6-digit hex string matching ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$ (e.g. '#ff8800'); an unrecognized or malformed value renders as black. Has no effect on text redaction.

dateFilterStrategy.description: A filter strategy for date values. Supports all base strategies plus date-specific strategies: TRUNCATE_TO_YEAR, SHIFT, and RELATIVE.

id.description: Optional identifier for this strategy instance, assigned by the policy author or generated, so the strategy and its condition can be referenced in logs and diagnostics without printing content that may be PII. Opaque to redaction behavior: it never changes how a document is filtered. Must not itself contain PII.

strategy.description: The redaction/replacement strategy to apply. Date filters support additional strategies: TRUNCATE_TO_YEAR, SHIFT, and RELATIVE.

redactionFormat.description: Format string for REDACT strategy. Supports placeholders: %t (filter type), %v (original value), %l (label).

maskLength.description: Length of the mask. SAME preserves the original length.

truncateLeaveCharacters.description: Number of characters to leave visible when using TRUNCATE strategy.

truncateCharacter.description: Character used to replace truncated portions.

truncateDirection.description: Which end of the value to truncate.

condition.description: Conditional expression that must be satisfied for this strategy to apply. If every strategy on a filter has a condition and none is satisfied, the value is left unchanged. Date filters support: 'token is birthdate', 'token is deathdate', 'token is birthdate or deathdate'.

salt.description: Whether to add a random salt to hashed values.

anonymizationCandidates.description: Custom candidate values for FROM_LIST anonymization method.

shiftRandom.description: Whether to shift dates by a random amount (SHIFT strategy).

shiftDays.description: Number of days to shift dates (SHIFT strategy).

shiftMonths.description: Number of months to shift dates (SHIFT strategy).

shiftYears.description: Number of years to shift dates (SHIFT strategy).

futureDates.description: Whether shifted dates may land in the future (SHIFT strategy).

color.description: Optional color of the bar drawn over a span redacted by this strategy when rendering a PDF or image. Overrides the policy-wide config.pdf.redactionColor for spans this strategy redacts; when unset, the policy-wide color (default black) applies. Accepts a named color (black, white, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, gray) or a 6-digit hex string matching ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$ (e.g. '#ff8800'); an unrecognized or malformed value renders as black. Has no effect on text redaction.

generators.description: Map of generator name to its definition. A MAP_REPLACE strategy references a generator by name to produce a replacement for a detected value absent from its lookup table.

generator.description: A named replacement generator. Targets a local model endpoint inside the deployment boundary so detected values are not sent to a third party.

type.description: Generator backend. 'ollama' calls a local Ollama-compatible generate endpoint.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the local generator endpoint (e.g. 'http://localhost:11434'). Must resolve inside the deployment boundary.

model.description: Model name the endpoint should use (e.g. 'llama3.1').

prompt.description: Prompt template. The placeholder {{token}} is replaced with the detected value and {{label}} with its entity label. The model must return only the replacement value.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the generator before falling back to the strategy's fallbackStrategy. Required so a generator can never block the pipeline indefinitely.

ageFilterStrategies.description: Strategies for handling detected age values. Strategies are evaluated in order, and the first one with no condition or a satisfied condition is applied. If every strategy has a condition and none is satisfied, the value is left unchanged. If no strategies are given, the value is redacted with the default format. To transform every detected value, end with a strategy that has no condition.

pattern.description: Java-compatible regular expression to match identifiers.

groupNumber.description: Regex capture group number to extract as the identifier (0 = entire match).

classification.description: Classification label assigned to matches from this identifier.

validator.description: Optional post-match validation. A regex match is kept only if the named built-in validator passes, so a generic identifier can reject format-valid but checksum-invalid values (for example a SIN that fails the Luhn check). Names a validator from the catalog (spec/v1.0/catalog/validators.yaml); no executable code is carried in the policy. An unknown name is a policy error, never silently ignored.

params.description: Validator-specific parameters, for example mod11 weights and variant, mod23-letter prefix substitutions, or mod97 letter substitutions. The accepted keys per validator are documented in the catalog.

removePunctuation.description: Remove punctuation from text before sending to the AI model.

thresholds.description: Confidence thresholds per label. Detections below the threshold are discarded.

phEyeConfiguration.description: Configuration for connecting to a PhEye AI service.

endpoint.description: URL of the PhEye service endpoint.

bearerToken.description: Bearer token for authenticating with the PhEye service.

maxIdleConnections.description: Maximum number of idle HTTP connections to maintain.

labels.description: Entity labels to detect (e.g. 'PER', 'LOC', 'ORG'). For a local GLiNER model these are the detection prompt.

modelPath.description: Filesystem path to a local GLiNER model directory (the ONNX model, the SentencePiece tokenizer, and the GLiNER config). When set, entities are detected with on-device inference instead of via the endpoint.

threshold.description: Minimum span confidence for the local model to return a detection. Defaults to 0.5.

phoneNumberFilterStrategies.description: Strategies for handling detected phone numbers. Strategies are evaluated in order, and the first one with no condition or a satisfied condition is applied. If every strategy has a condition and none is satisfied, the value is left unchanged. If no strategies are given, the value is redacted with the default format. To transform every detected value, end with a strategy that has no condition.

region.description: Default region(s), ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (for example "US", "GB", "FR"), used to interpret phone numbers written without an international "+" country code. A string sets a single region; an array enables detection for each listed region (each is scanned and the results are merged). Numbers with a "+" prefix are detected regardless of this value. Default "US".

leniency.description: How strictly a candidate must match to be detected, using libphonenumber's leniency levels. "POSSIBLE" accepts numbers whose length is possible for the region. "VALID" also requires the number to be valid under the region's numbering plan, which drops candidates such as short numeric identifiers or years. "STRICT_GROUPING" also requires the digits to be grouped as in one of the number's formats, and "EXACT_GROUPING" requires them to be grouped exactly as in one of those formats. Validity follows numbering-plan rules only; it does not establish that a number is assigned or in service. Values are case-sensitive. Default "POSSIBLE".

Strategies are evaluated in order, and the first one with no condition or a satisfied condition is applied. If every strategy has a condition and none is satisfied, the value is left unchanged.
